checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are portrait 480x854 with full-bleed artwork and no bars. The 8 s duration is taken from the frame labels.

must.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons move slowly against dark background
must.why: Blue and purple translucent ribbons on near-black change shape across the frames. The mid-clip morph is a bit large.

must.item: Top third mostly dark and uncluttered, brightest ribbons lower
must.why: The top 40% or more is dark in every frame. The ribbons sit in the middle to lower-middle of the frame.

must.item: No visible jump at loop boundary
must.why: The 7.6 s frame closely matches the 0.8 s frame and the start still. The clip was set to start and end on the same frame.

must.item: No words, clock graphics or interface elements

must.why: Audio cannot be checked from stills. The assistant says the video is silent.

faults.what: Ribbons sit in the middle of the frame (about 45–75% down) and reach up to about 45%, so there is little glow in the lower quarter. This is acceptable but not strongly 'low'.
At 3.2 s the ribbon changes shape noticeably into a twisted, smoky form and brightens, which is more than 'slow gentle' motion. The ribbon has a soft glow haze above it.
Output is 480p, so it is soft. The stills show slight compression artefacts and banding.
The loop seam and the sound track could not be verified from the stills. The 7.6 s frame matches the first frame, which suggests the loop closes.

summary: A clean portrait video of blue and purple ribbons on a dark background with a dark top and an apparently closed loop. It is slightly low-res and the mid-clip morph is somewhat strong.
